title: Täna maksan mina
topic: two friends order in a café, get each other's drinks and one of them forgets his wallet

sentences.sk: Täna on esmaspäev.
sentences.en: Today is Monday.

sentences.sk: Kati ja Toomas istuvad kohvikus akna all.
sentences.en: Kati and Toomas are sitting in a café by the window.

sentences.sk: Tere! Mida te soovite?
sentences.en: Hello! What would you like?

sentences.sk: Mina tahan teed piimaga, palun.
sentences.en: I want tea with milk, please.

sentences.sk: Ja mina tahan kohvi ja vett.
sentences.en: And I want coffee and water.

sentences.sk: Meil on ka suppi ja väga head kooki.
sentences.en: We also have soup and very good cake.

sentences.sk: Mis kook see on?
sentences.en: What kind of cake is it?

sentences.sk: Õunakook. See on täna väga värske.
sentences.en: Apple cake. It is very fresh today.

sentences.sk: Siis võtan supi ja koogi, palun.
sentences.en: Then I'll take the soup and the cake, please.

sentences.sk: Mina ei taha midagi süüa.
sentences.en: I don't want to eat anything.

sentences.sk: Andres toob tee, kohvi ja vee.
sentences.en: Andres brings the tea, the coffee and the water.

sentences.sk: Aga kohvi saab Kati ja tee saab Toomas.
sentences.en: But Kati gets the coffee and Toomas gets the tea.

sentences.sk: Toomas, see on sinu kohv, mitte minu!
sentences.en: Toomas, this is your coffee, not mine!

sentences.sk: Ja see on sinu tee!
sentences.en: And this is your tea!

sentences.sk: Kati ja Toomas naeravad.
sentences.en: Kati and Toomas laugh.

sentences.sk: Supp on kuum ja kook on magus.
sentences.en: The soup is hot and the cake is sweet.

sentences.sk: Kati, see kook on väga hea. Kas sa tahad tükki?
sentences.en: Kati, this cake is very good. Do you want a piece?

sentences.sk: Jah, aitäh. Sul on õigus, see on tõesti hea.
sentences.en: Yes, thanks. You're right, it really is good.

sentences.sk: Siis kutsub Toomas ettekandja.
sentences.en: Then Toomas calls the waiter.

sentences.sk: Arve, palun.
sentences.en: The bill, please.

sentences.sk: Supp, kook, kohv, tee ja vesi. See teeb kokku kaksteist eurot.
sentences.en: Soup, cake, coffee, tea and water. That comes to twelve euros altogether.

sentences.sk: Toomas otsib rahakotti, aga ei leia seda.
sentences.en: Toomas looks for his wallet, but he can't find it.

sentences.sk: Kati, mu rahakott on kodus!
sentences.en: Kati, my wallet is at home!

sentences.sk: Pole hullu. Täna maksan mina.
sentences.en: Never mind. Today I'm paying.

sentences.sk: Aitäh! Homme maksan mina ja võtame jälle kooki.
sentences.en: Thank you! Tomorrow I'm paying, and we'll have cake again.

sentences.sk: Hea küll. Aga homme võtad rahakoti kaasa!
sentences.en: All right. But tomorrow you bring your wallet!

recap: Kati and Toomas order tea, coffee, soup and cake in a café. The waiter mixes up their drinks, and when the bill comes Toomas's wallet is at home, so Kati pays.

sul.gloss: you (sul on õigus: you are right)
